question: Does giving the log-reading VLM the two calibrated per-token signals — token change z (MS-146) and token trust (trust head) — as continuous inputs raise cloud stability and evidence-date accuracy over C_lora on unseen events, at the same LoRA budget?
arm: E_trust_z: identical to C_lora (latest 64 tokens + rule-log text, LoRA r=16) except the 64 latest-observation tokens are augmented with two channels pooled to the same 4x4 grid: z_t (token change vs the previous CLEAR acquisition, gap/season-calibrated with the table fitted on the training regions) and trust_t (trust-head p(untrusted), head trained with the held-out event excluded); projector input 770 -> 2048 -> H. No thresholds anywhere: both signals are continuous.
controls: E_z_only and E_trust_only ablations if E_trust_z passes
data_and_eval: sequential_qa_v1, same 150-tile subsamples, same scorer and questions as stage 2; LOEO-consistent signals: for each unseen event the z table and the trust head come from the other three events

decision_rules.signal_helps: E_trust_z beats C_lora on cloud_stability AND Q_when on >= 2 of 3 unseen events by >= .03 each with tile-paired CI excluding 0
decision_rules.no_help: otherwise: the calibrated signals do not transfer into the reader; reported as a negative result next to MS-142/143

unlock_condition: MS-147 trust_usable = true, or a documented partial (>= 3 folds AUC >= .90) with the payoff shortfall stated
unlock_record: MS-147: trust head AUC >= .90 on 4/4 folds (.945-.995); registered payoff rule NOT met (0/4): hard masking removes 70-80% of cloudy pairs from scoring and cuts residual inflation by 21-64%; normal-set clause mis-specified. Shortfall stated; partial-unlock condition satisfied.
signals_provenance: arrival_v0/<region>/signal_fp16 from signal_maps_v0.py: per region R, z table fitted on the other three regions, trust head trust_heldout_R.pt (real run; hashes in vlm_trust_reader_v0/code_snapshot/TRUST_HEADS.sha). LOEO-consistent for all four regions including the training region hiroshima.
execution: GPU1: E_trust_z, then E_z_only, then E_trust_only (ablations run regardless, for the negative-result table); same LoRA budget and eval subsamples as stage 2; decision vs C_lora (stage 2 scores)
